messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx rate and latency observed for inference in eu-west-1 starting ~2998879900. Trigger: routing_policy_evaluation_errors > 5% for 3m. Paging oncall

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z: config-schema migration v2.4 applied to prod (removed legacy 'route_fallback' field). Change-id: cfg-2026-0315-09

maya (oncall): seeing a spike on the dashboards. Thanks for the heads-up. Investigating now. Can someone confirm if any traffic shift happened with that deploy? @priya

priya (eng-platform): yep, that migration was the rolling change. We removed the legacy field and left fallback_policy unspecified in a few service configs; default behavior now is to attempt model-variant affinity rather than global region failover. Might be the cause. More in a sec.

sam (sre): EU latency up to 1.3s p50 and 2xx->5xx rate increased ~4x for targets routing to 'fast-lite-v2'. Logs show many model-variant mismatch errors: "variant_not_available -> fallback_attempt_failed" repeated.

maya (oncall): paging product and cs. julie, david, FYI — possible customer impact on EU traffic. julie, can you surface any tickets?

julie (customer-success): already seeing a few shoulder tickets from EU customers complaining about intermittent failures. Escalating to tier2.

david (product): this is bad for latency-sensitive features. Any quick mitigation? Can we force the old fallback behavior until we patch configs?

priya (eng-platform): we can hotfix the platform config to re-enable region fallback by setting explicit 'fallback_policy: global_regional_fallback' per-service. Doing a dry-run against staging now.

infra-bot: runbook check: CONFIG_ROLLBACK playbook available at https://internal/redwood/runbooks/config-rollback

sam (sre): Maya, can you run a targeted rollback of the last schema migration on the routing-control cluster? If not rollback, at least pin routing for high-traffic customers to previous variant.

maya (oncall): initiating canary revert for routing-control in eu-west-1 now. Will follow with status. /deploy revert cfg-2026-0315-09 --scope routing-control --region eu-west-1

deploy-bot: Revert job started: revert-2998880123-1. Estimated completion 30s.

maya (oncall): revert completed at 2998880245. Early signals: 5xx rate dropping on affected instances. p50 latency improving. Still watching.

sam (sre): Confirming logs: variant_not_available errors decreased 90% after revert. But some requests still misrouted due to cached policy rules TTL (cache TTL 60s). Expect fully stable in ~2m.

priya (eng-platform): I'll push an explicit config patch to set 'fallback_policy: global_regional_fallback' for the affected services and add schema validator to fail CI if fallback_policy is empty. Pushing patch now.

priya (eng-platform): PATCH: applied patch cfg-2026-0315-09b to prod: added explicit fallback_policy values and schema strict validation. Waiting on CI gating (should be green in ~1m).

infra-bot: config-change detected: cfg-2026-0315-09b — validation passed. Distributing to routing-control. Cache invalidation issued.

maya (oncall): seeing customer errors drop to baseline. julie, any new tickets incoming? Should we notify impacted customers proactively?

julie (customer-success): Yes please. I'll draft a short note: "We've identified a transient routing configuration change that caused intermittent failures for EU-hosted inference; issue mitigated, full rollback + patch applied. We're following up with RCA." I'll send to top 10 impacted customers.

david (product): We need a clearer mitigation in the runbook: auto-set fallback_policy on schema migration, and a preflight validator for non-empty fallback_policy. Also add a hook to guard cached policy TTLs.

sam (sre): Agreed. Also add alerting rule for sudden increase in model-variant_mismatch errors specifically.

maya (oncall): Handing off to Sam for post-incident cleanup and RCA. Oncall done for this page. @sam, you own postmortem and follow-ups.

sam (sre): Taking over. Initial timeline: 09:12 change applied -> 09:13 spike starts -> 09:14 paging -> 09:15 revert -> 09:17 metrics normalizing. Root cause: schema migration removed deprecated 'route_fallback' without setting new default fallback_policy; default semantics changed, leading to affinity-preserving routing that couldn't resolve model variants in eu pool and oscillated fallback attempts.

priya (eng-platform): Notes for RCA: migration script did not fail when fallback_policy omitted; CI didn't catch missing field due to permissive schema compatibility. Patch: make field required or provide explicit default equivalent to previous behavior.

sam (sre): Quick technical snapshot (for postmortem):

```
# offending snippet (pre-migration)
routing:
  route_fallback: true
  preferred_variant: fast-lite

# post-migration bug (omitted field)
routing:
  preferred_variant: fast-lite
  # fallback_policy missing -> default affinity-only
```

Result: system attempted variant affinity, couldn't find variant in eu cluster for some customers (variants were drained for maintenance), fallback attempts failed instead of falling back to other regions.

priya (eng-platform): Follow-ups: 1) Add CI validator to reject schema migrations that remove fallback fields without explicit mapping. 2) Telemetry: emit an event when fallback_policy is unset. 3) Docs: migration guide for routing schema. 4) Runbook update to include immediate rollback and explicit config patch steps.

david (product): Also need to communicate impact: % of requests affected ~3.7% of global inference traffic, concentrated in EU, roughly 12 customers with >1% error increase. Good to include in customer comms.

julie (customer-success): I'll include those stats in the customer note and offer priority support for any regressions.

maya (oncall): closing page on my side. Sam, please add follow-up tickets and tag eng-platform + infra. I'll mark incident as mitigated in pagerduty.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Create postmortem when assigned owner updates incident timeline.

sam (sre): Will own the postmortem. Assigning tickets:
- PM-3421: Add CI schema validator for routing fallback_policy (assigned: priya)
- SRE-3422: Alert for variant_mismatch spike (assigned: sam)
- DOCS-3423: Migration guide + rollout checklist (assigned: david)
- CS-3424: Customer comms follow-up (assigned: julie)

priya (eng-platform): I'll get CI validator out today and follow up with a PR for the migration guide.

david (product): Thanks everyone. Quick retro note: when we change schema semantics, we need a canary that simulates variant unavailability to validate fallback behavior. Adding to roadmap.

julie (customer-success): Sent customers the note. No immediate escalations so far.

sam (sre): Closing thread here. Will attach timeline + metrics to the postmortem doc. Thanks for fast responses everyone. :thumbsup:
